headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds took down the Athletics 6-5, the New York Mets defeated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, and the Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Seattle Mariners right-handed pitcher Cole Wilcox, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other players impacted by injuries include Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Joe Ryan, Cleveland Guardians right-handed pitcher Slade Cecconi, Chicago White Sox left-handed pitcher Chris Murphy, Chicago White Sox catcher Joey Bart, Toronto Blue Jays second baseman Luis Urías, and Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Luinder Avila.

The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins on August 5, 2026. Berry joins the Royals' roster following the trade. Additionally, the Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.
